environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate in account 555666777888. IAM role arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/auth-svc-prod-task has an attached permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::555666777888:policy/BoundaryEnforceSessionIntegrity) that includes a Deny statement on dynamodb:PutItem when the condition key 'dynamodb:LeadingKeys' does not match a pattern requiring the session's origin_domain attribute to be present and match the configured allowed domains. Additionally, an SCP (id: p-a8b3c9d2) attached to the OU denies sts:AssumeRole for any principal whose session tags do not include 'validated_redirect=true', which is only set by a Lambda@Edge function that performs strict URL origin validation (exact match against a pinned allowlist with no suffix matching) before forwarding to the ALB. The Lambda@Edge sets a signed header X-Validated-Redirect with an HMAC that the ALB target group health check validates. Without this header, requests to /auth/callback return 403 from the ALB's fixed-response rule.

config.alb_rules: Fixed-response 403 on /auth/callback unless X-Validated-Redirect header present with valid HMAC
